title: Agno: Lightweight Framework
description: Agno agent with OpenAIChat model and DuckDuckGoTools for web search, show_tool_calls displays the tool interactions.

steps.description: Agno example: imports, Agent creation with model and tools, print_response.
Pip install: agno and duckduckgo-search packages.
Imports: Agent from agno.agent, OpenAIChat from agno.models.openai, DuckDuckGoTools from agno.tools.duckduckgo.
Agent: Agent with OpenAIChat model (gpt-4o-mini), DuckDuckGoTools list, show_tool_calls=True.
Execution: print_response with Tour de France question triggers web search.
